phase0/phase21.18-current-verification-regression.mjs recomputes the 11-entry PHASE21.18 manifest; the historical PHASE21.16 manifest is identity-preserved only.

phase0/phase22.12-hashes-documentation-regression.mjs recomputes PHASE22.12-SOURCE-HASHES.sha256, which includes package.json; phase22.13 invokes it, but current CI workflow wiring must be considered separately.
phase0/p1-24-p1-final-snapshot.mjs asserts root and backend Node >=24 engines and key script aliases; it does not recompute all 156 historical package.json manifests.

limitations: CI command mapping is based on explicit `run:` lines in the 11 workflow YAML files; shell scripts, composite actions, and commands invoked by a Node script are not expanded unless the package script itself explicitly calls npm run.
Suite tags are name-based routing aids and can overlap; they are not a substitute for test-content inspection.
A package script not directly called in CI is not necessarily unused; it may be manual, invoked by a non-CI workflow, or retained for historical compatibility.
No package.json changes were made; no historical script was deleted or rewritten.
